lines.zh: 我走一步，故事就往前一段
lines.en: Each step moves the story on.

lines.zh: 我在这条路上讲了很久
lines.en: I have told this on this road a long while.
I walk to the rhythm of sentences.
I walk toward you; no hurry.
My shadow does not match me.
Silence follows where I walk.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边数你的错
lines.en: I count your faults as I walk.
I laid this road.
I will finish speaking before I come close.
I shift toward you.
My footsteps are telling something.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，因为你不必跑
lines.en: I walk slowly; you need not run.
I am choosing my words.
We have much left to say.
I am still; the story is not.

lines.zh: 你看这周围，都是我记得的
lines.en: Look around; I remember all of this.

lines.zh: 我数着你说过的每一句
lines.en: I count every line you have said.
My voice is not quite human.
I pause so you can think.
I have practiced these words for years.
You will hear it all eventually.
I have no need to close my eyes.
This chapter's ending is unwritten.
I wait for you to ask something.

lines.zh: 你安静的时候最像证人
lines.en: You look most like a witness when silent.
You look at me; I will tell you.
All of this is your fault.
You do not remember; I do.
Your hands played a part.

lines.zh: 我讲了很多次，你都忘了
lines.en: I told it many times; you forgot.
Your eyes look the same as then.
I want you to hear every word.
I know you want to leave.
Sit down; it is long.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我记忆里的那扇门
lines.en: You stand where my memory has a door.
I will lay it out, step by step.
Your silence sounds like a confession.

lines.zh: 我说的每个字都有出处
lines.en: Every word I say has a source.

lines.zh: 你在发抖，是因为想起来了
lines.en: You tremble; you are remembering.
There is only me and you here.
You cut my words short.
I paused for a moment.
That will not change the conclusion.
I swallowed half a sentence.
The wound is here; so are the words.
You do not want to hear it all.
I lost half a sentence.
You are growing impatient.
I knew you would strike.
Do not think this lets you leave.

lines.zh: 你以为吃东西能打断我
lines.en: You think eating will interrupt me.
I do not eat; I tell.
Put it down; let us continue.
Your hands are distracted.
That smell changes nothing.
Which part would you rather hear?
Eat; I do not mind waiting.
The story outlasts the food.

lines.zh: 你 chew 得很慢，我知道你在拖延
lines.en: You chew slowly; I know you are stalling.
Look at me; do not look down.
You bumped into my sentence.
Step back; I am not finished.
My body is harder than it looks.
A bump cannot interrupt me.
I go on with what I was saying.
That counts in the story too.
Do not stand in my way.

lines.zh: 别碰我，故事还没讲到你的部分。
lines.en: Don't touch me — the story hasn't reached your part.
That is not part of the story.
I have no such role.
You just cut me off.
Sit and hear me out.
I did not come to pair.

lines.zh: 我的存在不属于那种关系
lines.en: My existence has no place for that.

lines.zh: 你问了个不相干的问题
lines.en: That question is irrelevant.
Let us return to that part.
You were not listening.
That is one more of your faults.
That is mine.
What are you doing with it?
It belongs to this story.
Put it down first.
I have noted that gesture.

lines.zh: 你捡东西的样子很心虚
lines.en: You look guilty picking that up.
It is in your hand; good.
Let me have a look at this.
This is my evidence.
Do not try to hide it.
At last, you have come.
We should talk.
Reaching this point is no surprise.
I prepared a long time.

lines.zh: 从你踏进来那刻就开始了
lines.en: It began the moment you stepped in.
I want you to hear it all before leaving.
You need not explain to me.
I want one answer.
Look me in the eye.
I will not skip this part.
This is not a threat; it is a statement.
I have been waiting.
Only you can understand it here.
Do not be so quick to argue.
I follow every word you say.
You want an exit; there is none that way.
I have told this road for ages.
Anywhere you go, it is the same.
My voice is behind you.
Do not turn; you will miss it.
Your steps have broken the rhythm.
I have not reached your part yet.
I saved a few passages.

lines.zh: 这里的门都通向我的故事
lines.en: Every door here opens into my story.
I speak as I walk.

lines.zh: 你数得清我说了几句吗
lines.en: Can you count how many lines I have said?

lines.zh: 我一直在重复，你没注意
lines.en: I have repeated it; you did not notice.
Your memory is unreliable.
I wait for you to fall quiet.
This road is long, but it ends.
We are almost there.
This blow is in the story too.
You interrupted yourself.
I barely touched you.
Your blood is darker than I remember.
I am getting tired of speaking.
This is not the point, only a pause.
You stepped back; you are listening.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了让你安静
lines.en: This was to make you quiet.
I spoke too heavily.
You covered your face.
The story is long; do not fall.
We continue from where we were.
Now you can hear me.
You have arrived at last.

lines.zh: 这里是故事开始的地方
lines.en: This is where the story starts.

lines.zh: 从 err 方块进来，对吧
lines.en: You came through the err block, did you not?
I have waited here a long time for you.
This place is my memory.
Nothing you see is real.
The door closed behind you.
I prepared an opening.

lines.zh: 你先坐，还不到站的时候
lines.en: Sit; it is not time to leave.

lines.zh: 这是我讲了许多次的地方
lines.en: I have told this place many times.
I know your footsteps well.
We start from the very beginning.
Do not interrupt what I have to say.

lines.zh: 这些墙听我讲了很多年
lines.en: These walls have heard me for years.
I kept a place for you.
You think this place is not real.

lines.zh: 我会讲到你能听懂为止
lines.en: I will speak until you understand.

lines.zh: 火焰把我的句子烤焦了
lines.en: Fire singed my words.
I fell, and the words broke off.
Water takes my voice.
The blast tore this chapter apart.
The arrow pinned me to that line.
Magic rewrote my lines.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但我讲得很累
lines.en: I do not eat, but speaking tires me.
Thunder drowned my words.
There is not even an echo here.
